product.title: BOW Sports Capital — GM Decision Game
product.summary: Nine branching front-office calls across three franchises.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students run three franchises in turn, each presenting three scenarios on contracts, trades, cap space, arbitration and free agency. Every choice is tagged accelerate, smooth or rebuild, and the next scenario is picked from what they chose last, so the path genuinely branches.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete and publicly reachable, implementing a design spec that ships alongside it. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16 across three full 9-decision runs. Scoring contains a dominant strategy: always choosing the middle SMOOTH option scores 45/45 on every decision regardless of scenario, while always-ACCELERATE and always-REBUILD both score 26/45.
knownBlockers: Dominant strategy: picking option B nine times without reading any scenario scores a perfect 45/45 and "Hall of Fame GM". This teaches "always pick the middle option" rather than the stated lesson that context decides.
The advertised "score 33+ to unlock your claim code" threshold is not enforced — two runs scoring 26/45 both unlocked codes, and the two different losing strategies received the identical code.

provenance.evidence: 301-M1-L1/js/teams-data.js defines TEAM_ORDER of three franchises and an unlock threshold of 33; js/game.js computes nine total scenarios and branches on choice type.
openQuestions: The bundled PDF is a build instruction addressed to an AI assistant, not a statement of audience. It is not evidence of a grade band.
